# Process Email
Reads unread emails from an IMAP inbox and runs the child steps once per message.
## When to use
- A scenario should react to incoming email, such as a support mailbox.
## How it works
1. Connects to the IMAP server and loads unread inbox messages. 2. For each message, sets from, subject, content and sentdate as the step parameters and runs the children (with LLM tool selection when there are several). 3. Moves the processed messages to the in-progress folder.
## Inputs
- `mailserver`: IMAP server host - `mailport`: IMAP server port - `mailusername`: Mailbox user name - `mailpassword`: Mailbox password
## Outputs
- `newmessages`, `agentid`, `agentoutput`, and from/subject/content/sentdate for each child run
## Implementation
- Bean `imapMailCheckerSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.ImapMailCheckerSkill` - Agent type: `remoteagent`

# Reply to Email
Sends a reply email over SMTP.
## When to use
- Last step of an email workflow, once the reply text has been written.
## How it works
1. Stops with an error if `reply_body` is missing. 2. Sends `reply_subject` and `reply_body` to `email` from `mailusername`, then runs the children.
## Inputs
- `mailserver`: SMTP server host - `mailport`: SMTP server port - `mailusername`: SMTP user name, also used as the From address - `mailpassword`: SMTP password - `ssl`: Use a secured connection - `email`: Recipient address - `reply_subject`: Subject of the reply - `reply_body`: Body of the reply
## Outputs
- The email is sent. The result is logged to the context
## Implementation
- Bean `imapMailSenderSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.ImapMailSenderSkill` - Agent type: `remoteagent`
